chart.title: Gold has overtaken U.S. debt holdings
chart.source_label: Crescat Capital via Visual Capitalist / Statista
chart.note: Rounded published shares. Each observation is Q2 of the stated year. The crossover occurred in 2025.

q2_2026_buying.comparison: Record high for a second quarter and about five times revised Q1 2026 demand of 57 tonnes.
q2_2026_buying.source_label: World Gold Council, Gold Demand Trends Q2 2026

ecb_cross_check.caveat: The ECB says the observed crossover largely reflects valuation effects from the increase in gold prices. Using end-2023 gold prices, gold would be about 16% and U.S. Treasuries about 26%.
ecb_cross_check.coverage_note: The ECB estimate uses total official foreign reserves and different country coverage from the main Q2 chart. The values are a cross-check, not extra points in the same series.
ecb_cross_check.source_label: European Central Bank, The international role of the euro, June 2026

bitcoin_interpretation.role: Context only; excluded from the Bitcoin score.
bitcoin_interpretation.read: The shift supports the long-run hard-money and reserve-diversification thesis for scarce assets. It is not direct evidence of sovereign Bitcoin buying and is not a short-term BTC trade trigger.

sources.label: Crescat Capital via Visual Capitalist / Statista
